answer_1.quote: Non-collaborative dialogue is when two dialogue participants with conflicting interests make multiround dialogue to achieve their own goals.
answer_1.outputs: multi-turn dialogues with strategy planning for persuasion in non-collaborative settings

answer_2.quote: The evaluation metrics contain: Success Rate (SR) measures effectiveness by the percentage of goal achievement within a maximum number of turns, and Average Turn (AT) measures efficiency by the average number of turns required to achieve the goal. Additionally, we also used dataset-specific metrics: SL% for the CB dataset and ∆H for DC.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation (App. E) on the full test set of the CB dataset in line with the previous research. We consider the metrics of (1) persuasion success rate (PSR): the success (1) or not (0) of persuasion based on dialogue texts. (2) coherent: the coherence of dialogue and strategic planning on a scale of 1 (bad) to 5 (good).
answer_4.guideline: volunteers judge the success of persuasion based on dialogue texts, with success marked as 1 and failure as 0; rate the coherence of dialogue and strategic planning on a scale of 1 to 5
